description: This file defines the 'Probe' class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance. It appears to implement a network probe mechanism with multicast discovery, request/response handling, and security features, likely for SSDP or similar protocols.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probing and discovery functionalities, including nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web requests for the probe, including data extraction and insertion.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting of SSDP-like M-SEARCH requests over the network, manages destinations and request creation.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security status.

methods.name: WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into a socket data frame.

methods.name: Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial request.

methods.name: Broadcaster::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a network request string for M-SEARCH.

methods.name: Broadcaster::ReceiveData
methods.description: Handles incoming data on the socket.

methods.name: Probe::Instance::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying instance data.

methods.name: Probe::Ping
methods.description: Triggers a broadcast ping with optional TTL.

methods.name: Probe::Instances
methods.description: Returns an iterator over discovered instances.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Reports a discovered probe instance with details.
